question: With which scientist did William Ramsay show in 1894 that air also contained an element unknown until then, which was named argon?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Rayleigh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• William Ramsay showed in **1894** that air contained an element unknown until then, which was named **argon,** with the help of Lord Rayleigh.
 
• Lord Rayleigh was a British physicist who won the **Nobel Prize** in Physics in 1904 for his discovery of argon.
 
• The discovery of** argon**, a noble gas that does not react with other elements, was made possible by the scientific collaboration of William Ramsay and John William Strutt, better known as Lord Rayleigh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hermann Staudinger:**

 
 
• He was a **German chemist** who is known for his work on **macromolecules.**
 
• He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in **1953**.
 
 
 
• **Glenn Seaborg:**
 
 
• He was an **American chemist** who discovered several new elements.
 
• He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in **1951**.
 
 
 
• **Harold Urey:**
 
 
• He was an **American chemist **who discovered deuterium, a heavy isotope of hydrogen.
 
• He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in **1934**.
